input: Build a capsule travel toiletry bag for carry-on

gold.taskTitle: Build a Carry-On Capsule Travel Toiletry Bag
gold.taskDescription: Curate and assemble a compact, TSA-compliant toiletry bag with only the essentials for carry-on travel.

questions.title: How many days will your typical trip last?
questions.description: Trip length determines how much product quantity is needed and whether full-size or travel-size items are more practical.

questions.title: What type of trip is this bag for?
questions.description: Knowing whether the trip is for business, leisure, adventure, or a mix shapes which toiletry categories to prioritize.

questions.title: Do you have any skincare or grooming products you consider non-negotiable?
questions.description: Identifying must-have items ensures the capsule bag is built around existing non-negotiables before filling in the rest.

questions.title: What is your budget for buying new travel-size products or containers?
questions.description: Budget affects whether to buy dedicated travel sizes, refillable containers, or repurpose what the user already owns.

questions.title: Do you prefer solid, liquid, or no-preference product formats?
questions.description: Solid formats like shampoo bars bypass TSA liquid limits entirely, which can significantly change the packing strategy.

questions.title: What toiletry bag or pouch do you currently own or plan to use?
questions.description: The size and compartment layout of the bag itself dictates how many items fit and how they should be organized.

questions.title: Will your destination provide any toiletries, like a hotel?
questions.description: Knowing what is already provided at the destination helps eliminate redundant items and keeps the bag truly minimal.
